εα.def: an interjection, Ho! Ah! Ha! It is supposed to imply surprise, fear and indignation.

εαω.def: I allow, permit, let alone, leave.

εβερ.def: Eber, father of Peleg and son of Shelah.

εβραιοσ.def: a Hebrew, particularly one who speaks Hebrew (Aramaic).

εβραισ.def: the Hebrew language, or rather: Aramaic.

εβραιστι.gloss: in the Hebrew or Aramaic dialect
εβραιστι.def: in the Hebrew, or rather, in the Aramaic dialect.

εγγιζω.def: trans: I bring near; intrans: I come near, approach.

εγειρω.def: (a) I wake, arouse, (b) I raise up.

εγκαινια.def: a renewal, dedication; the feast of rededication.

εγκαλεω.gloss: I bring a charge against, accuse
εγκαλεω.def: I bring a charge against, accuse.

εγκαταλειπω.def: I leave in the lurch, abandon (one who is in straits), desert.

εγκομβοομαι.def: I clothe myself (originally: I tie round in a knot).

εγκοπη.def: an incision, a cutting, break; met: an interruption, a hindrance.

εδαφιζω.def: I dash to the ground, level with the ground.

εζεκιασ.def: Hezekiah, son of Ahaz, father of Manasseh, and king of Judah (727-686 [?] B.C.).

εθναρχησ.def: an ethnarch, tribal lord, a subordinate ruler.

εθνικοσ.gloss: pagan, heathen, gentile; a Gentile, non-Jew
εθνικοσ.def: pagan, heathen, gentile; subst: a Gentile, non-Jew.

εθνικωσ.def: in the manner of Gentiles, like the rest of the world.

εθνοσ.def: a race, people, nation; the nations, heathen world, Gentiles.

εθοσ.def: a custom, habit; an institute, rite.

ειδοσ.def: visible form, shape, appearance, outward show, kind, species, class.

ειδωλειον.def: a temple for (containing) an image (an idol).

ειδωλοθυτοσ.def: (of meat), sacrificed to an image (or an idol).

ειδωλολατρεια.gloss: worship or service of an image

ειδωλολατρησ.def: a server (worshipper) of an image (an idol).

εικη.def: without a cause, purpose; purposelessly, in vain, for nothing.

ειρηνευω.gloss: I am peaceful, keep the peace, am at peace
ειρηνευω.def: I am peaceful, keep the peace, am at peace.

ειρηνη.def: peace, peace of mind; invocation of peace a common Jewish farewell, in the Hebraistic sense of the health (welfare) of an individual.

εισ.def: into, in, unto, to, upon, towards, for, among.

εισαγω.def: I lead in, bring in, introduce.

εισειμι.def: I go in, enter (originally: I shall go in).

εισερχομαι.gloss: I go in, come in, enter
εισερχομαι.def: I go in, come in, enter.

εισκαλεομαι.def: I call in (to my house), invite.

εισπορευομαι.def: I journey in(to), I go in(to), enter, intervene.

εισφερω.def: I lead into, bring in, announce.

ειτα.def: then, thereafter, next (marking a fresh stage); therefore, then, furthermore.

ειωθα.gloss: I am accustomed, custom, what was customary
ειωθα.def: I am accustomed, custom, what was customary.

εκ.gloss: from out, out from among, from
εκ.def: from out, out from among, from, suggesting from the interior outwards.

εκαστοσ.def: each (of more than two), every one.

εκατονταρχησ.def: a centurion of the Roman army.

εκβαλλω.gloss: I throw, cast, put out, banish, bring forth, produce
εκβαλλω.def: I throw (cast, put) out; I banish; I bring forth, produce.

εκβασισ.def: (a) a way out, escape, (b) result, issue.

εκβολη.def: a throwing out, a jettisoning of cargo to lighten a ship.

εκδιδωμι.gloss: I give out, let, let out for my own advantage
εκδιδωμι.def: I give out, let; middle: I let out for my own advantage.

εκδικεω.gloss: I give justice over, defend, avenge, vindicate
εκδικεω.def: I give justice over, defend, avenge, vindicate.

εκδικησισ.def: (a) a defense, avenging, vindication, vengeance, (b) full (complete) punishment.

εκδικοσ.def: avenging, subst: an avenger (the word occurs frequently in the sense of a special advocate [champion] of a city).

εκδιωκω.def: I persecute, expel by persecuting, drive out, vex, harass.

εκδυω.gloss: I put off, take off, strip off
εκδυω.def: I put off, take off, strip off, with acc. of person or garment or both.

εκει.def: (a) there, yonder, in that place, (b) thither, there.

εκζητεω.def: I seek out, seek out after, require.

εκθαμβεομαι.def: I am greatly astonished, am awe-struck.

εκθετοσ.def: cast out, exposed (to the elements), abandoned.

εκκλησια.def: an assembly, congregation, church; the Church, the whole body of Christian believers.

εκκλινω.gloss: I fall away from, turn away
εκκλινω.def: (lit: I bend away from), I fall away from, turn away (from), deviate.

εκκομιζω.def: I carry out (of the city gate for burial).

εκκοπτω.def: I cut out (off, away), remove, prevent.

εκκρεμαννυμι.def: I hang out, mid: I hang upon.

εκλανθανομαι.def: I forget entirely, make to forget.

εκλεγομαι.def: I pick out for myself, choose, elect, select.

εκλειπω.def: I fail, die out, come to an end, am defunct.

εκλεκτοσ.def: chosen out, elect, choice, select, sometimes as subst: of those chosen out by God for the rendering of special service to Him (of the Hebrew race, particular Hebrews, the Messiah, and the Christians).

εκλογη.gloss: a choosing out, selecting, choice by God
εκλογη.def: a choosing out, selecting, choice (by God).

εκλυω.gloss: I am unstrung, become weak, fail
εκλυω.def: I loose, release, unloose (as a bow-string), relax, enfeeble; pass: I am faint, grow weary.

εκμυκτηριζω.gloss: I deride, scoff at, mock greatly
εκμυκτηριζω.def: I deride, scoff at, mock greatly.

εκνευω.def: I escape, get clear of, deviate, withdraw.

εκνηφω.gloss: I return to soberness of mind
εκνηφω.def: I return to soberness of mind.

εκουσιοσ.def: willing, with right good will, voluntary, spontaneous.

εκουσιωσ.def: willingly, of one's own accord, spontaneously.

εκπειραζω.gloss: I put to the test, make trial of, tempt
εκπειραζω.def: I put to the test, make trial of, tempt, try.

εκπιπτω.gloss: I fall out, fall off, fall away, fade away, wither away
εκπιπτω.def: I fall out, fall off, fall away; hence in nautical language: I fall off from the straight course; of flowers: I fade away, wither away; I fall from, lose, forfeit; I am cast ashore; I am fruitless.

εκπλεω.def: I sail out (of harbor), sail away.

εκπληροω.gloss: I fill completely, fulfill in every particular
εκπληροω.def: I fill completely, fulfill in every particular (to the utmost), make good.

εκπλησσω.def: I strike with panic or shock; I amaze, astonish.

εκπνεω.def: (lit: I breathe out), I breathe my last, expire.

εκπορευομαι.def: I depart from; I am voided, cast out; I proceed from, am spoken; I burst forth, flow out, am spread abroad.

εκπτυω.gloss: I spit upon, disdain, reject, loathe
εκπτυω.def: I spit out, disdain, reject, loathe.

εκριζοω.def: I root out, pluck up by the roots.

εκστασισ.def: (properly: distraction or disturbance of mind caused by shock), bewilderment, amazement; a trance.

εκστρεφω.gloss: I change for the worse, corrupt, pervert
εκστρεφω.def: I change for the worse, corrupt, pervert.

εκτεινω.def: I stretch out (forth), cast forth (as of an anchor), lay hands on.

εκτελεω.def: I complete, bring to completion, carry out, perform.

εκτενησ.def: intent, constant, strenuous, intense; met: earnest, zealous.

εκτιθημι.gloss: I put out or expose a child, set forth, explain
εκτιθημι.def: (a) I put out or expose a child, (b) mid: I set forth, expound, explain.

εκτινασσω.def: I shake off; mid: I shake off from myself.

εκτοσ.gloss: without, outside, except, the outside, apart from
εκτοσ.def: (a) adv: (1) without, outside, beyond, (2) except, (3) subst: the outside, (b) prep: outside, apart from.

εκτρεπω.def: (lit: I turn out from); mid. and pass: I turn aside (from the right road), wander, forsake, and with an object: I remove from myself, shun, avoid.

εκτρωμα.def: (strictly: a lifeless abortion) an untimely birth.

εκφερω.def: I bring out, carry out, sometimes out of the city for burial; I bring forth, bear, produce.

εκφευγω.gloss: I flee out, away, I escape
εκφευγω.def: I flee out, away, escape; with an acc: I escape something.

εκφυω.gloss: I put forth, cause to sprout
εκφυω.def: I put forth, cause to sprout.

εκχεω.def: I pour out (liquid or solid); I shed, bestow liberally.

εκχωρεω.def: I go out, depart from, withdraw, flee.

εκψυχω.gloss: I breathe my last, die, expire
εκψυχω.def: I breathe my last, die, expire.

ελαια.def: an olive tree; the Mount of Olives.

ελαμιτησ.def: an Elamite, one of a people living to the north of the Persian Gulf in the southern part of Persia.

ελαυνω.def: (a) trans: I drive (on), propel, (b) intrans: I row.

ελαχιστοσ.def: least, smallest, but perhaps oftener in the weaker sense: very little, very small.

ελεαζαρ.def: Eleazar, son of Eliud, and father of Matthan.

ελεγχοσ.def: a proof, possibly: a persuasion; reproof.

ελεγχω.def: (a) I reprove, rebuke, discipline, (b) I expose, show to be guilty.

ελεημοσυνη.def: abstr: alms-giving, charity; concr: alms, charity.

ελευθερια.def: freedom, liberty, especially: a state of freedom from slavery.

ελιακειμ.def: Eliakim, son of Abiud and father of Azor; son of Melea and father of Jonam.

ελιεζερ.def: Eliezer, son of Joram and father of Joshua.

ελιουδ.def: Eliud, son of Achim, and father of Eleazar.

ελισαβετ.def: Elizabeth, mother of John the Baptizer.

ελισσω.def: I roll, roll up, fold up.

ελκοω.def: I afflict with sores; pass: I am afflicted with sores.

ελκυω.def: I drag, draw, pull, persuade, unsheathe.

ελλασ.def: Hellas, the native name for Greece.

ελλην.def: a Hellene, the native word for a Greek; it is, however, a term wide enough to include all Greek-speaking (i.e. educated) non-Jews.

ελληνιστησ.def: a Hellenist, Grecian Jew, a Greek-speaking Jew, that is one who can speak Greek only and not Hebrew (or Aramaic).

ελλογεω.gloss: I charge to, put to one's account
ελλογεω.def: I charge to, put to one's account, impute.

ελμωδαμ.def: Elmadam, father of Cosam, son of Er.

ελπιζω.def: I hope, hope for, expect, trust.

ελυμασ.def: Elymas, the name of the sorcerer at Paphos.

εμβαινω.def: I step in; I go onboard a ship, embark.

εμβατευω.def: I enter, set foot on, intrude, pry into.

εμβιβαζω.def: trans: I embark, put on board, step into.

εμβλεπω.def: I look into (upon); met: I consider; I see clearly.

εμβριμαομαι.def: I snort (with the notion of coercion springing out of displeasure, anger, indignation, antagonism), express indignant displeasure with some one; I charge sternly.

εμμανουηλ.def: Emmanuel, a Messianic title derived from Isaiah 7:14 = God with us.

εμμαουσ.def: Emmaus, a village not far from Jerusalem.

εμμενω.gloss: I remain or abide in, abide by, maintain
εμμενω.def: I remain (abide) in, abide by, maintain, persevere in.

εμμορ.def: Hamor, a man whose sons sold a field at Shechem to Jacob.

εμπεριπατεω.gloss: I walk about in a place
εμπεριπατεω.def: I walk about in a place, live among, am conversant with.

εμπιπτω.gloss: I fall in, am cast in
εμπιπτω.def: I fall in, am cast in, am involved in.

εμπλεκω.def: I enfold, entangle; pass: I am involved in.

εμπορευομαι.gloss: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade
εμπορευομαι.def: I travel as a merchant, engage in trade; I traffic in, make gain or business of.

εμποριον.def: a place of traffic, mart, market, market-house.

εμποροσ.def: a merchant, trader; one on a journey.

εμπρηθω.gloss: I burn, set on fire, suffer inflammation
εμπρηθω.def: I burn, set on fire, suffer inflammation.

εμπροσθεν.def: in front, before the face; sometimes made a subst. by the addition of the article: in front of, before the face of.

εμφανιζω.gloss: I make visible, report against, appear before
εμφανιζω.def: I make visible (manifest); hence: I report (inform) against; pass: I appear before.

εμφυτοσ.def: inborn, ingrown, congenital, natural, rooted, implanted.

εναντιον.gloss: before, in the presence of, in the eyes of
εναντιον.def: before, in the presence of, in the eyes of.

εναρχομαι.def: I begin (in), make a beginning, commence.

ενδειγμα.def: (a thing proved, hence) a plain token (sign, proof).

ενδειξισ.def: a showing, proof, demonstration, sign, token.

ενδημεω.def: I am at home, live in a place.

ενδιδυσκω.def: (somewhat rare) (of clothing: I put on another); mid: I put on (myself).

ενδομησισ.gloss: the material of a building, a structure
ενδομησισ.def: the material of a building, a structure.

ενδοξαζω.def: I glorify, acknowledge the glory belonging to, recognize as glorious; pass: I am glorified in.

ενδυναμοω.def: I fill with power, strengthen, make strong.

ενδυνω.def: I clothe; mid: I enter, creep into.

ενεδρευω.gloss: I lie in wait for, seek to entrap, defraud, deceive
ενεδρευω.def: I lie in wait (ambush) for, seek to entrap (hence: I defraud, deceive).

ενειλεω.gloss: I wrap up, roll up in something
ενειλεω.def: I wrap up, roll up in (something), wind in.

ενεκεν.gloss: for the sake of, on account of, wherefore
ενεκεν.def: for the sake of, on account of, on account of which, wherefore, on account of what, why.

ενεργεια.def: working, action, productive work, activity; in the NT, confined to superhuman activity.

ενεργεω.def: I work, am operative, am at work, am made to work, accomplish; mid: I work, display activity.

ενεργησ.def: effective, productive of due result, at work.

ενεχω.def: (a) I have a grudge against, am angry (with), (b) pass. or mid: I am entangled, entangle myself.

ενθυμεομαι.def: I meditate upon, reflect upon, ponder.

ενιστημι.gloss: I place in or upon, am at hand, am present, threaten
ενιστημι.def: I place in or upon; only in the intrans. tenses: I impend, am at hand, am present, threaten; as adj: present.

εννευω.gloss: I make a sign to by nodding
εννευω.def: I make a sign to by nodding.

εννοια.def: thinking, consideration; a thought, purpose, design, intention.

εννομοσ.def: (a) legal, statutory, duly constituted, (b) under the law, obedient to the law.

ενοικεω.gloss: I dwell in, am settled in
ενοικεω.def: I dwell in, am settled (stationary) in; met: I am indwelling.

ενοχλεω.def: I disturb, cause tumult, trouble, annoy.

ενοχοσ.def: involved in, held in, hence: liable, generally with dat. (or gen.) of the punishment.

ενταφιασμοσ.gloss: embalming, preparation of a body for burial
ενταφιασμοσ.def: embalming, preparation of a body for burial.

εντευθεν.gloss: hence, from this place, on this side and on that
εντευθεν.def: hence, from this place, on this side and on that.

εντευξισ.def: (lit: approaching the king, hence a technical term), a petition, prayer, intercession.

εντιμοσ.def: (held precious, hence) precious, honored, honorable in rank.

εντοπιοσ.gloss: belonging to the place, native, resident
εντοπιοσ.def: belonging to the place, native, resident; subst: a citizen.

εντρεπω.gloss: I turn to confusion, put to shame, reverence
εντρεπω.def: (a) I turn to confusion, put to shame, (b) mid: I reverence, regard.

εντρεφω.gloss: I nourish on, am educated in
εντρεφω.def: I nourish (sustain) on, am educated in.

εντυγχανω.gloss: I meet, encounter, call upon, make a petition
εντυγχανω.def: (a) I meet, encounter, hence: (b) I call (upon), make a petition, make suit, supplication.

εντυλισσω.gloss: I wrap up, roll round, envelop
εντυλισσω.def: I wrap up, roll round, envelop.

ενυβριζω.def: I insult, outrage, treat contemptuously, mock at.

ενυπνιαζομαι.def: I dream (see visions) in my sleep.

ενωπιον.gloss: before the face of, in the presence of
ενωπιον.def: before the face of, in the presence of, in the eyes of.

ενωσ.def: Enosh (also Enos), son of Seth, and father of Cainan.

ενωτιζομαι.gloss: I take into my ear, listen to
ενωτιζομαι.def: I take into my ear, give ear to, listen to.

ενωχ.def: Enoch, son of Jared and father of Methuselah.

εξαγοραζω.def: I buy out, buy away from, ransom; mid: I purchase out, buy, redeem, choose.

εξαγω.def: I lead out, sometimes to death, execution.

εξαιρεω.def: I take out, remove; sometimes (mid): I choose, sometimes: I rescue.

εξαιτεω.def: I demand of, ask for, beg earnestly for.

εξαλειφω.def: I plaster, wash over; I wipe off, wipe out, obliterate.

εξαναστασισ.def: a rising up and out, resurrection.

εξανατελλω.def: I rise (spring) up out (of the ground).

εξανιστημι.def: (a) in trans. tenses: I raise up, cause to grow, (b) in intrans. tenses: I rise up from.

εξαπορεομαι.gloss: I am utterly without resource, am in despair
εξαπορεομαι.def: I am utterly without resource, am in despair.

εξαποστελλω.def: I send away, send forth (a person qualified for a task).

εξαρτιζω.def: (a) I fit up, completely furnish, equip, furnish, supply, (b) I accomplish, finish.

εξαστραπτω.def: I flash forth like lightning, gleam, am radiant.

εξειμι.def: (originally: I shall go out), I go out (away), depart.

εξελκω.def: (lit: I draw out of the right place, or I draw aside out of the right way), I entice.

εξερευναω.def: I search diligently, I examine carefully (minutely).

εξεταζω.def: I examine, question, inquire at, search out.

εξηγεομαι.def: I lead, show the way; met: I unfold, narrate, declare.

εξησ.gloss: next in order, the next day
εξησ.def: next in order, the next day, the following day, at the period immediately following.

εξηχεω.def: I sound out (forth) (referring either to the clearness or to the loudness of the sound).

εξισ.def: condition, state, habit, use, especially: good condition of body or soul.

εξιστημι.def: (lit: I remove from a standing position), (a) in trans. tenses: I astonish, amaze, (b) in intrans. tenses: I am astonished, amazed; I am out of my mind, am mad.

εξισχυω.gloss: I have strength for, am perfectly able
εξισχυω.def: I have strength for (a difficult task), am perfectly able.

εξοδοσ.def: (a) an exit, going out, departure from a place; the exodus, (b) death.

εξολοθρευω.def: I destroy utterly, annihilate, exterminate, root out.

εξομολογεω.def: (a) I consent fully, agree out and out, (b) I confess, admit, acknowledge (cf. the early Hellenistic sense of the middle: I acknowledge a debt), (c) I give thanks, praise.

εξορκιζω.def: I adjure, put to oath; I exorcise.

εξορκιστησ.def: an exorcist, a caster out of evil spirits by the use of names or spells.

εξορυσσω.def: (a) I dig out, hence: I open up, (b) I gouge.

εξουδενοω.def: I set at naught, ignore, despise.

εξουθενεω.def: I set at naught, ignore, despise.

εξουσια.def: (a) power, authority, weight, especially: moral authority, influence, (b) in a quasi-personal sense, derived from later Judaism, of a spiritual power, and hence of an earthly power.

εξουσιαζω.def: I exercise (wield) power (authority), pass: I am ruled, am held under authority.

εξωθεν.def: (a) from outside, from without, (b) outside, both as adj. and prep; with article: the outside.

εξωθεω.def: I drive out, expel, propel, thrust out; I drive out of the sea, drive on shore.

εορταζω.def: I take part in a festival, keep a feast (allegorically).

επαγω.def: I bring upon; met: I cause to be imputed to.

επαθροιζω.gloss: I gather together, crowd upon, press around
επαθροιζω.def: I gather together, pass: I crowd upon (some one), press around.

επαισχυνομαι.def: I am ashamed, am ashamed of.

επαιτεω.def: I beg, am a beggar, ask alms.

επακολουθεω.def: I follow close after, accompany, dog; I imitate, pursue, am studious of.

επακροαομαι.def: I listen to, hear, hearken to.

επαναγω.def: (a) nautical: I put out (from the shore), (lit: I take up a ship on to the high seas), (b) I go up, possibly: I go up again, return.

επαναμιμνησκω.def: I remind, possibly: I remind again.

επαναπαυομαι.gloss: I rest upon, rely on, trust in
επαναπαυομαι.def: I rest upon, rely on, trust in.

επανιστημι.def: intrans. tenses: I rise up against.

επανω.gloss: on the top, above, superior to
επανω.def: (a) adv: on the top, above, (b) prep: on the top of, above, over, on, above, more than, superior to.

επαρκεω.gloss: I aid, relieve, do service, render help
επαρκεω.def: I aid, relieve, do service, render help, am strong enough for.

επαφρασ.def: Epaphras, Epaphroditus, a Colossian Christian, in captivity with Paul in Rome.

επαφριζω.def: I foam out (a metaphor from the seaweed and refuse borne on the crest of waves), vomit forth.

επαφροδιτοσ.def: Epaphras, Epaphroditus, a Colossian Christian, in captivity with Paul in Rome.

επει.def: of time: when, after; of cause: since, because; otherwise: else.

επειδη.def: of time: when, now, after that; of cause: seeing that, forasmuch as.

επεισαγωγη.def: bringing in (besides or in addition), introduction, importation.

επενδυομαι.def: I have on over (as a garment); mid: I put on myself in addition.

επενδυτησ.def: a coat, outer wrap or tunic.

επερχομαι.def: I come to, arrive, come on, come upon, attack.

επερωτημα.def: inquiry, request, appeal, demand; a profession, pledge.

επεχω.gloss: I hold forth, pay attention, note, delay
επεχω.def: (a) trans: I hold forth, (b) intrans: I mark, pay attention (heed), note; I delay, stay, wait.

επηρεαζω.def: I insult, treat wrongfully, molest, revile.

επι.gloss: on, to, against, on the basis of, at
επι.def: on, to, against, on the basis of, at.

επιβαινω.def: (a) I set foot on, step on, (b) I mount (a horse), board (a vessel).

επιβαλλω.gloss: I throw upon, lay, strike upon
επιβαλλω.def: (a) I throw upon, cast over, (b) I place upon, (c) I lay, (d) intrans: I strike upon, rush.

επιβαρεω.def: I put a burden on, am burdensome.

επιβλεπω.def: I look with favor on, regard.

επιβοαω.gloss: I cry out to or against
επιβοαω.def: I cry out to or against.

επιγαμβρευω.gloss: I marry a deceased brother's wife
επιγαμβρευω.def: I take to wife after, marry a deceased brother's wife.

επιγειοσ.def: (a) on the earth, belonging to the earth (as opposed to the sky), (b) in a spiritual sense, belonging to the earthly sphere, earthly (as opposed to heavenly).

επιγινομαι.def: I arise, spring up, arrive, come on.

επιγινωσκω.gloss: I come to know, discern, recognize
επιγινωσκω.def: I come to know by directing my attention to him or it, I perceive, discern, recognize; aor: I found out.

επιγνωσισ.def: knowledge of a particular point (directed towards a particular object); perception, discernment, recognition, intuition.

επιγραφω.def: I write upon, inscribe, imprint a mark on.

επιδεικνυμι.def: I show, display, point out, indicate; I prove, demonstrate.

επιδημεω.def: I sojourn, am resident (temporarily, in a foreign city).

επιδιατασσομαι.def: I make an additional testamentary disposition, I furnish with additions.

επιδιδωμι.gloss: I hand in, give up, give way
επιδιδωμι.def: (a) trans: I hand in, give up, (b) intrans: I give way (to the wind).

επιδιορθοω.def: I set in order besides, put in order, correct.

επιδυω.def: I sink, set, set during, go down.

επιεικησ.def: gentle, mild, forbearing, fair, reasonable, moderate.

επιζητεω.gloss: I seek after, desire, search for
επιζητεω.def: I seek after, desire, search for, make inquiries about.

επιθανατιοσ.gloss: at the point of death, condemned to death
επιθανατιοσ.def: at the point of death, condemned to death.

επιθεσισ.def: a laying on; an attack, assault.

επιθυμεω.gloss: I long for, covet, lust after
επιθυμεω.def: I long for, covet, lust after, set the heart upon.

επιθυμια.gloss: desire, eagerness for, inordinate desire, lust
επιθυμια.def: desire, eagerness for, inordinate desire, lust.

επικαθιζω.def: I sit upon, cause to sit upon.

επικαλεω.gloss: I call by an additional name, appeal to
επικαλεω.def: (a) I call (name) by a supplementary (additional, alternative) name, (b) mid: I call upon, appeal to, address.

επικαλυπτω.def: I put a cover on, cover up.

επικαταρατοσ.def: on whom a curse has been invoked, accursed, doomed to destruction.

επικειμαι.def: (a) dat: I am placed upon, am laid upon, lie upon, am imposed; I press upon, (b) absol: I press hard, am insistent, insist.

επικουρειοσ.def: an Epicurean, one who holds the tenets of Epicurus.

επιλαμβανομαι.def: I lay hold of, take hold of, seize (sometimes with beneficent, sometimes with hostile, intent).

επιλεγω.gloss: I call, choose for myself, am named
επιλεγω.def: I call; mid: I choose for myself; pass: I am named.

επιλοιποσ.def: remaining, that is left over, still left.

επιλυω.def: I loose, release; I solve, settle, explain, interpret, decide.

επιμαρτυρεω.def: I testify earnestly, bear witness to.

επιμελεομαι.gloss: I take care of, attend to
επιμελεομαι.def: I take care of, attend to.

επιμενω.def: (a) I remain, tarry, (b) I remain in, persist in.

επινευω.def: I nod to, assent to, consent.

επιορκεω.gloss: I take an oath, swear falsely
επιορκεω.def: I take an oath, swear falsely.

επιπιπτω.def: I fall upon, press upon, light upon, come over.

επιπλησσω.def: I rebuke, chide, reprove, strike at.

επιποθεω.gloss: I long for, strain after, desire greatly
επιποθεω.def: I long for, strain after, desire greatly, have affection for.

επισκεπτομαι.gloss: I look upon, visit, look out, select
επισκεπτομαι.def: I look upon, visit, look out, select.

επισκηνοω.gloss: I raise a tent over, dwell
επισκηνοω.def: I raise a tent (over), dwell, spread a tabernacle over.

επισκοπεω.def: I exercise oversight, care for, visit.

επισκοποσ.def: (used as an official title in civil life), overseer, supervisor, ruler, especially used with reference to the supervising function exercised by an elder or presbyter of a church or congregation.

επισπαομαι.def: (lit: I draw over), mid: I become as uncircumcised.

επιστελλω.gloss: I write, send by letter to.

επιστηριζω.def: I prop up, uphold, support, confirm, make stronger.

επιστομιζω.def: I muzzle, silence, stop the mouth.

επιστρεφω.def: (a) trans: I turn (back) to (towards), (b) intrans: I turn (back) (to [towards]); I come to myself.

επισχυω.def: I persist, insist, am more urgent.

επισωρευω.gloss: I heap up, obtain a multitude of
επισωρευω.def: I heap up, obtain a multitude of.

επιτιθημι.gloss: I put, place upon, lay on
επιτιθημι.def: I put, place upon, lay on; I add, give in addition.

επιτιμαω.def: (a) I rebuke, chide, admonish, (b) I warn.

επιτρεπω.def: I turn to, commit, entrust; I allow, yield, permit.

επιτροποσ.def: (a) (procurator) a steward, (b) (tutor) a guardian (appointed for an "infant" [under 14 perhaps] by the father or by a magistrate).

επιφαινω.def: I appear (as of a light in the heavens or from the heavens), shine upon.

επιφαυω.gloss: I shine upon, give light to
επιφαυω.def: I shine upon, give light to.

επιφωνεω.def: I call out, shout, clamor at.

εποκελλω.def: I force forward, run (a ship) aground.

επονομαζω.gloss: I name, impose a name on
επονομαζω.def: I name, impose a name on; pass: am named.

εποπτευω.gloss: I am an eyewitness of, behold
εποπτευω.def: I am an eyewitness of, behold, look upon.

επουρανιοσ.def: heavenly, celestial, in the heavenly sphere, the sphere of spiritual activities; met: divine, spiritual.

εραστοσ.def: Erastus, steward of Corinth, a Christian.

εργαζομαι.def: I work, trade, perform, do, practice, commit, acquire by labor.

εργασια.def: working, activity, work, service, trade, business, gains of business, performance, practice.

εργατησ.def: a field-laborer; then: a laborer, workman in general.

εργον.def: work, task, employment; a deed, action; that which is wrought or made, a work.

ερεθιζω.def: I stir up, arouse to anger, provoke, irritate, incite.

ερειδω.def: I stick fast, prop, fix firmly.

ερευγομαι.def: (lit: I belch forth, hence) I utter, declare.

ερεω.def: (denoting speech in progress), (a) I say, speak; I mean, mention, tell, (b) I call, name, especially in the pass., (c) I tell, command.

ερημια.def: a desert place, desert, uninhabited region.

ερημοσ.def: as an adj: deserted, desolate, waste; hence: the desert, to the east and south of Palestine; of a person: deserted, abandoned, desolate.

ερημοω.def: (a) I make desolate, bring to desolation, destroy, waste, (b) of a person: I strip, rob.

εριθεια.def: (the seeking of followers and adherents by means of gifts, the seeking of followers, hence) ambition, rivalry, self-seeking; a feud, faction.

ερμηνευω.def: (a) I translate, explain, (b) I interpret the meaning of.

ερμησ.def: (a) Hermes, the messenger and herald of the Greek gods, or rather the corresponding Lycaonian deity, (b) Hermes, a Roman Christian.

ερπετον.def: a creeping creature, reptile, especially a serpent.

ερωταω.def: (a) I ask (a question), question, (b) I request, make a request to, pray.

εσθιω.def: I eat, partake of food; met: I devour, consume (e.g. as rust does).

εσλι.def: Esli, son of Naggai and father of Nahum.

εσοπτρον.def: a mirror, looking-glass (made of highly polished metal).

εσρωμ.def: Hezron, son of Perez, father of Ram.

εσχατοσ.def: last, at the last, finally, till the end.

εσχατωσ.def: extremely, utterly; to be at the extremity, to be "in extremis," to be at the last grasp.

εσω.def: within, inside, with verbs either of rest or of motion; prep: within, to within, inside.

εσωθεν.def: (a) from within, from inside, (b) within, inside; with the article: the inner part, the inner element, (c) the mind, soul.

εσωτεροσ.def: inner; with the article: the part that is within.

ετερογλωσσοσ.def: speaking another language; subst: one who speaks another language.

ετεροδιδασκαλεω.def: I teach different things, that is, different from the true or necessary teaching.

ετεροζυγεω.gloss: I am yoked with one different from myself
ετεροζυγεω.def: I am yoked with one different from myself, unequally yoked.

ετεροσ.def: (a) of two: another, a second, (b) other, different, (c) one's neighbor.

ετι.def: (a) of time: still, yet, even now, (b) of degree: even, further, more, in addition.

ευ.def: well, well done, good, rightly; also used as an exclamation.

ευα.def: Eve, the first woman; wife of first man Adam.

ευαγγελιζω.gloss: I bring good news, preach good tidings
ευαγγελιζω.def: I bring good news, preach good tidings, with or without an object, expressing either the persons who receive the good news or the good news itself (the good news being sometimes expressed as a person).

ευαγγελιον.def: the good news of the coming of the Messiah, the gospel; the gen. after it expresses sometimes the giver (God), sometimes the subject (the Messiah, etc.), sometimes the human transmitter (an apostle).

ευαγγελιστησ.gloss: an evangelist, bearer of good tidings
ευαγγελιστησ.def: an evangelist, a missionary, bearer of good tidings.

ευαρεστεω.def: I give pleasure to, please (perhaps with the added idea of: rendering good service to).

ευβουλοσ.def: Eubulus, a Christian with Paul in Rome.

ευγενησ.def: (a) of noble birth, of high birth, (b) noble in nature.

ευδοκεω.def: I am well-pleased, think it good, am resolved.

ευδοκια.def: (a) good-will (good-pleasure), favor, feeling of complacency of God to man, (b) good-pleasure, satisfaction, happiness, delight of men.

ευεργεσια.def: good action, well-doing, benefiting, kind service.

ευεργετεω.def: I do good deeds, perform kind service, benefit.

ευθυμεω.def: I keep up spirit, am cheerful, am of good courage.

ευθυνω.def: (a) I make straight (of the direction, not the surface, of a road), (b) I guide, steer.

ευθυσ.def: adj: (a) straight of direction, as opposed to crooked, (b) upright; adv: immediately.

ευκαιρεω.gloss: I have a good opportunity, have leisure
ευκαιρεω.def: I have a good (favorable) opportunity, have leisure; I devote my leisure to.

ευκαιροσ.def: opportune, timely, suitable; perhaps sometimes: holiday, festival.

ευλαβεομαι.def: I fear, am anxious, am cautious; I reverence.

ευλαβησ.def: (lit: handling well, hence) cautious, circumspect; hence: God-fearing, pious.

ευλογεω.def: (lit: I speak well of) I bless; pass: I am blessed.

ευλογητοσ.def: (used only of God), blessed (as entitled to receive blessing from man), worthy of praise.

ευμεταδοτοσ.def: willingly sharing, ready to impart, generous.

ευνουχιζω.def: I make into a eunuch, emasculate, castrate.

ευνουχοσ.gloss: a eunuch, keeper of the bed-chamber
ευνουχοσ.def: (a) a chamberlain, keeper of the bed-chamber of an eastern potentate, eunuch, (b) a eunuch, castrated person, or one who voluntarily abstains from marriage.

ευοδια.def: Euodia, or rather Euhodia, a Christian woman of Philippi.

ευοδοω.gloss: I cause to prosper, have a happy journey
ευοδοω.def: I cause to prosper, pass: I have a happy (successful) journey, hence: I prosper.

ευπορεω.def: I have means, am prosperous, enjoy plenty.

ευπροσωπεω.gloss: I make a fair outward appearance
ευπροσωπεω.def: I look well, make a fair show (a good outward appearance, and so win good opinion).

ευρισκω.def: I find, learn, discover, especially after searching.

ευσεβεω.def: I am dutiful, pious, show piety towards, worship.

ευσημοσ.def: with clear meaning, intelligible, clear to the understanding.

ευσχημων.def: (a) comely, seemly, decorous, (b) of honorable position (in society), wealthy, influential.

ευτυχοσ.def: Eutychus, a young hearer of Paul at Troas.

ευφημοσ.gloss: well reported of, spoken in a kindly spirit
ευφημοσ.def: well reported of, spoken in a kindly spirit, laudable, reputable.

ευφορεω.gloss: I bear well, bring a good harvest
ευφορεω.def: I bear well, bring a good harvest, yield abundantly.

ευφραινω.gloss: I cheer, am glad, make merry
ευφραινω.def: I cheer, make glad; generally mid. or pass: I am glad, make merry, revel, feast.

ευφρατησ.def: the Euphrates, boundary river of the province Syria.

ευχαριστεω.def: I thank, give thanks; pass. 3 sing: is received with thanks.

ευχαριστια.def: thankfulness, gratitude; giving of thanks, thanksgiving.

ευχη.def: a prayer comprising a vow; a prayer, vow.

ευωνυμοσ.def: (lit: well-named, to avoid the evil omen attaching to the left), on the left-hand side, left.

εφαπαξ.def: once, once for all; at once.

εφεσοσ.def: Ephesus, a coast city, capital of the Roman province Asia.

εφημερια.def: a class of priests who served for a stated number of days.

εφημεροσ.def: for the day, daily, necessary for every day.

εφικνεομαι.gloss: I come to, reach as far as
εφικνεομαι.def: I come to, reach as far as.

εφιστημι.gloss: I stand by, am urgent, befall one, impend
εφιστημι.def: I stand by, am urgent, befall one (as of evil), am at hand, impend.

εωσ.def: (a) conj: until, (b) prep: as far as, up to, as much as, until.
